name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Performance Marketing & B2B Demand Gen | Google, LinkedIn, Meta, HubSpot
summary: Hands-on B2B performance marketer with 15+ years across agency, MarTech, and SaaS, building campaigns inside the platforms and reporting in terms the business cares about: pipeline, CAC, and ROI. Runs Google Ads hands-on, built A/B-tested LinkedIn campaigns for small, researched B2B audiences, and is Meta Ads certified. Keeps tracking clean with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and HubSpot, and uses AI tools daily to research, write, and scale outreach. Disciplined about documentation and data hygiene.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Optimized a client's Google Ads account to cut spam and low-quality leads and improve click quality, then diagnosed on-site conversion as the remaining bottleneck rather than spending more on traffic.
Install Google Tag Manager on every site built and implement GA4 tracking directly in site code, so campaign results can be measured outside the ad platforms.
Build dashboards in Power BI and GA4 tracking lead generation, funnel progression, and campaign ROI, writing SQL for BigQuery/GA4 pulls.
Write direct-response ad copy, landing pages, and email and SMS sequences, and built 20+ automated lifecycle workflows that convert and retain leads.
Built an AI-assisted audit and outreach workflow and grew it through LinkedIn content: 180+ businesses enrolled, 2 converted to paying clients.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Advised clients on ad-spend budget planning and allocation across paid campaigns.
Designed account-based LinkedIn ad campaigns targeting small, highly researched audiences with A/B-tested setups.
Built reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering QBRs and optimization recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Led integrated strategy across inbound, paid media, and content, and produced landing pages and conversion-focused copy.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed 15-20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention), and tracked the book in Salesforce.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed paid media and creative performance at a performance marketing agency and turned results into optimization recommendations.
Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each (~$130K+ total).

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Contributed to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8).

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
